record.reason: NegT2IBench is a text-to-image polarity benchmark with controlled positive/negative constraints and detector-based scoring, validated with human labels across models. It measures generation adherence, not LLM inference efficiency; the linked VLM paper is only a broad multimodal connection.
record.title: NegT2IBench: When Negation Changes the Picture. A Polarity Benchmark for Text-to-Image Models
